description: This Java class 'DefaultCommandConfig' provides a configuration implementation for command timeout settings within a gateway service. It encapsulates default and maximum timeout durations, is built from a scoped configuration, and includes standard methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultCommandConfig
classes.description: Implements CommandConfig, encapsulating default and max timeout durations with configuration-based instantiation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance based on a provided Config object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare timeout durations.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on timeout durations.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration object.
